content.identity: 빈 섬에서 주민과 시설의 생활 연결망을 직접 만들어 가는 작은 공동체 성장 게임으로 재설계한다. 플레이어는 무인도 마을에서 Gather a focused set of island resources.을 중심으로 선택 결과가 다음 월드 상태를 바꾸는 CASUAL 게임이다. 대표 선택과 세계 규칙이 결합되어 같은 장르의 단순 반복과 다른 경로·위험·결과를 만든다. 성장할수록 새 행동 조합·경로·관계·발견·대응법 중 장르에 맞는 가능성이 실제 플레이에 열린다.

coreLoop: Gather a focused set of island resources. -> Use them to build or improve one village function.
Unlock a new resident, activity or area and choose the next village goal.
Repeat the process to grow the village and unlock new possibilities.

signatureSystems.name: ISLAND_RESOURCE_MANAGER
signatureSystems.purpose: Manage and allocate island resources to build or improve village functions
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Select which resource to gather and how to use it for village development

signatureSystems.name: VILLAGE_GROWTH_PLAN_MANAGER
signatureSystems.purpose: Manage the progression of resources to village functions and track growth milestones.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Select which resource to gather, which function to build/improve, and what next goal to unlock.

signatureSystems.name: VILLAGE_GROWTH_STRATEGY_ENGINE
signatureSystems.purpose: Manage the strategic progression of village development and resource allocation.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Select a new resident, activity, or area to unlock and determine the next goal based on current resources and goals.

signatureSystems.name: VILLAGE_GROWTH_EXPANSION_ENGINE
signatureSystems.purpose: Facilitates the expansion of village growth through strategic planning and resource management.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Select a new resident, activity, or area to unlock and set the next goal for village development.

signatureSystems.name: VILLAGE_GROWTH_CATALYST
signatureSystems.purpose: Facilitates the progression of village growth by enabling the unlocking of new residents, activities, or areas and guiding the selection of next goals.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Select a resource to unlock a new resident/area and choose the next village goal.
